limits: Isolated loopback HTTP/TLS, null audio and in-memory test credentials. Guest DB restart and same-process room recreation; persistent host-key reconstruction is covered by Rust tests.
checks: native projection supplies pinned host identity; public metadata excludes host paths and original track IDs
host room target uses the existing local favorite identity without duplication
guest personal favorite is private, desired-state idempotent and excludes ephemeral cover capabilities
favorite resolves to currently authorized resource; repeated queue occurrences share one personal favorite
revoked sharing removes live resolution and rejects old resource; reshare preserves bookmark with a fresh capability
personal favorite does not grant queue permission or lose stored metadata after permission revocation
bounded reference resolution and malformed LAN favorite rejection
guest service restart preserves the SQLite favorite and resolves after fresh authenticated join
room recreation retains host-scoped favorite identity while replacing session resource IDs
another host sharing the same music cannot resolve the original host's favorite identity
repeated un-favorite is idempotent and cannot mutate the host's personal favorites
